== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sanctum is a highly secure world and the headquarters for the [[Abidan]] organization. It serves as one of several vital worlds that the [[Abidan]] intend to protect and quarantine to act as a final defense against infinite chaos. The central planet of this iteration is characterized by an immense, golden city that covers nearly the entire landmass, leaving only small, manicured gardens to maintain ecological balance. This environment is exceptionally stable due to powerful natural laws and ancient defenses, making it much safer than other worlds. The [[Abidan]] maintain a significant presence here, with most of their various Divisions headquartered on the planet. A primary landmark is the [[Hall of Judgment]], a massive golden tower situated on an artificial hill that serves as a symbol of security and [[Authority|authority]]. This complex is where members of the [[Court]] of Seven convene to make critical decisions regarding the [[Executor program]]. Additionally, the [[Phoenix Division]] operates within Sanctum. Orbiting the central planet is an industrial-style station known as [[The Grave|the Grave]], which functions as a briefing and operational hub for those traveling through [[Way|the Way]].}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sanctum is a golden, planet-spanning city that serves as the central world located beneath [[The Grave]]. As an [[Abidan]]-settled [[Iteration]], this stable world possesses natural laws and defenses with greater weight than other worlds. [[The Grave]] floats above the surface of Sanctum, while [[Threshold]] acts as the primary line of defense against potential [[Vroshir]] incursions. Situated near the [[Iteration]] being visited, Sanctum also serves as the location for [[Phoenix Division]] headquarters.}}
